description: Nestled in the lower hills of Tarzana, just South of Ventura Blvd, this exquisite single-story residence was once a celebrity-owned compound, and offers a rare blend of classic elegance and modern luxury. Sitting on a sprawling, half-acre flat lot, this timeless 3 bedroom + office/den, 3 bath home is a private sanctuary designed for peaceful everyday living. Stepping through the front doors, you are greeted by warm hardwood floors, refined architectural details, and an abundance of natural light. The home features a large formal living room anchored by a beautiful bay window that perfectly frames the picturesque grounds. A spacious family room boasts high ceilings, a relaxing fireplace, and another charming bay window. This inviting space flows seamlessly into the oversized dining room, where French doors open directly to the backyard. The gourmet chef’s kitchen is appointed with a center island, stunning Carrera marble countertops, an abundance of custom cabinetry, and a sunlit breakfast area. It is fully equipped with state-of-the-art SubZero & Thermador appliances, a Miele stove and steamer, and a built-in wine refrigerator. When it is time to relax, the primary suite serves as a peaceful haven, featuring French doors that open to the backyard. Surrounded by a lush canopy of mature trees lining the entire perimeter, the park-like backyard provides complete privacy and a tranquil atmosphere. A sparkling swimming pool and elevated spa sit gracefully alongside an expansive patio and a large, manicured grassy lawn. Completing this magnificent property is a dedicated laundry room with washer and dryer, a covered front porch, circular driveway, and an attached two-car garage with carriage doors and built-in storage, making this an unparalleled opportunity to own a timeless, turn-key home in a premier location.
